+# notes

+A minimal Python package for creating and persisting notes.
+
+- `create_note(text)` — returns a `Note` with an auto-generated UUID and the given text.

+from notes.storage import save, load

+loaded = load("note.json")

+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from notes.models import Note
+
+
+def save(note: Note, path: str) -> None:
+    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps({"id": note.id, "text": note.text}))
+
+
+def load(path: str) -> Note:
+    data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
+    return Note(id=data["id"], text=data["text"])
